input.quote: 5.3 Sublicenses. AbbVie shall have the right to grant sublicenses (or further rights of reference), through multiple tiers of Sublicensees, under the licenses and rights of reference granted in Sections 5.1.1, 5.1.2 and 5.1.3, to its Affiliates and other Persons; provided that any such sublicenses shall be consistent with the terms and conditions of this Agreement and AbbVie shall remain liable for its obligations under this Agreement and for the performance of all Sublicensees.
input.rationale: The grant in our favour meets the preferred position. Section 5.1.3 grants AbbVie an exclusive licence (and right of reference) to Exploit the Licensed Compounds and Products in the Field in the Territory, automatically effective on the License Option Exercise Closing Date, with no revocability at Harpoon's discretion. Section 5.3 lets us sublicense through multiple tiers to our Affiliates and other Persons (covering contractors acting on our behalf), and Sections 5.4/5.5 confirm Affiliate and Third Party distribution and co-promotion rights at our sole discretion. Section 12.1.2 converts the Section 5.1.3 grants into a fully-paid, royalty-free and irrevocable licence on expiry of the Term, and Section 13.4.1 permits assignment of the Agreement (and thus the licence) without Harpoon's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, stock or asset sale, with the grant binding on Harpoon's successors. Termination is confined to the specified grounds in Article 12 (including uncured material breach) rather than being at Harpoon's will. The grant-back to Harpoon in Section 5.2 is appropriately narrow: non-exclusive, royalty-free, no sublicensing other than to permitted subcontractors, and solely as necessary to perform the Initial Development Plan. No redline required.
